RULE-1.gloss: If x invited n guests with no-show fraction f, and 1 − f = a, then the fraction of guests attending is a

RULE-2.gloss: If x invited n guests and the fraction attending is a, and n × a = g, then x has g attending guests
RULE-2.formula: ∀x∀n∀a∀g (Invited(x,n) ∧ Amount(x, attend_fraction, a) ∧ Product(n,a,g) → Amount(x, attending, g))

RULE-3.gloss: If x has g attending guests and gives p gift bags per guest, and g × p = b, then x needs b gift bags
RULE-3.formula: ∀x∀g∀p∀b (Amount(x, attending, g) ∧ PerGuest(x,p) ∧ Product(g,p,b) → Amount(x, bags_needed, b))
RULE-3.verify_reason: the 0.75 rate is defined per invited guest (already accounting for the 1/4 no-show), so it should be multiplied by the invited count (16), not by the already-reduced attending count; applying it to attending guests double-counts the no-show reduction.

RULE-4.gloss: If x needs b gift bags and each costs c, and b × c = t, then x's total cost is t
RULE-4.formula: ∀x∀b∀c∀t (Amount(x, bags_needed, b) ∧ PricePerBag(x,c) ∧ Product(b,c,t) → Amount(x, total_cost, t))
